notes: CIS Critical Security Controls provide prioritized, actionable security guidance. Controls are ordered by effectiveness and scaled for organization size through Implementation Groups (IG1-IG3). Maps to NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and other frameworks. Community-driven, consensus from practitioners.

Prescriptive, consensus-developed secure-configuration recommendations for 100+ specific technologies across 25+ vendor product families (cloud platforms, containers, databases, operating systems, mobile devices, network devices), produced through open CIS Benchmarks Communities and freely downloadable as PDFs for non-commercial use. Registry-only entry per DATA-HOSTING-RULES.md (#63): CIS Benchmarks prose and PDFs are copyrighted by CIS under a non-commercial/no-redistribution license; SecID registers benchmark identities, versions, and recommendation ID patterns without redistributing per-check prose.
